name: MrScraper
description: Data, SEO and Scraping: AI-powered web scraping platform with APIs for AI scrapers, HTML fetching, e-commerce/travel scrapers, results and analytics.
access_notes: API tokens are created self-serve in the dashboard (profile > API Tokens) and sent in the x-api-token header (analytics endpoints take the token name as a query param). A permanent free plan with monthly token allowance and no credit card is documented; paid plans (Pro $199/mo etc.) add volume, residential proxies and pay-as-you-go overage.
mcp_notes: Official cloud-hosted vendor MCP at https://mcp.mrscraper.com/mcp (Bearer API token), documented at docs.mrscraper.com. No Composio toolkit found (composio.dev/toolkits/mrscraper returns 404).
uncertainty_notes: Webhook support not found in the docs pages reviewed. Free-plan token allowance is small (docs billing page says 100 tokens/month while the pricing page shows 1,000), so real workloads need a paid plan.

evidence.note: All endpoints require API token in x-api-token header; analytics endpoints use apiTokenName query param; REST base api.app.mrscraper.com
Self-serve API token generation from the dashboard (profile > API Tokens > New Token)
Free plan with monthly tokens and no credit card required; Standard/Pro/Enterprise tiers
Official cloud-hosted MrScraper MCP server at mcp.mrscraper.com/mcp with Bearer API-token auth
